title: Build vs. buy: when off-the-shelf software wins, and when you need custom

points.heading: When buying off-the-shelf wins
points.body: For generic, well-understood processes, standard SaaS is almost always the right choice.

points.heading: When building custom wins
points.body: Custom software earns its keep in a narrower set of cases than vendors would like you to believe — but when it fits, the payoff is large.

points.heading: The numbers, side by side
points.body: Take a 30-person company that needs a system to manage a specific operational workflow.

cta.headline: The full piece is on the site.
